incident.trigger: KubeSolo did not shut down cleanly (crash, fatal error, kill or power loss)

Remove /var/lib/kubesolo/kine/db/state.db-wal and /var/lib/kubesolo/kine/db/state.db-shm manually, or restart with --db-wal-repair to remove them automatically.
